+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour),
+		DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageKeyEncipherment | x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+	certPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
+	keyPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(key)}))
+
+	redis := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/redis.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithNewFile("/redis.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: keyPEM}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379", "--tls-cert-file", "/redis.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/redis.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/redis.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"})
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis.AsService()).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_BYTES", certPEM)
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3355837
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache connection configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, //nolint:gosec // explicitly requested by the operator
+		}
+
+		var caCert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			caCert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			caCert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+
+		if len(caCert) > 0 {
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert) {
+				return nil, errors.New("invalid redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"net"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(nil)
+	defer server.Close()
+	ca := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: server.Certificate().Raw})
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, ca, 0600))
+
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+	}{
+		{name: "inline CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertBytes: string(ca)}},
+		{name: "CA path", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertPath: path}},
+		{name: "insecure", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{InsecureSkipTLS: true}},
+		{name: "system roots", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			cfg := test.cfg
+			cfg.RequireTLS = true
+			client, err := NewClient(cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if cfg.CaCertPath != "" || cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+				require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+				require.NotEmpty(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs.Subjects())
+			} else {
+				require.Nil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+			conn, err := tls.DialWithDialer(&net.Dialer{Timeout: time.Second}, "tcp", server.Listener.Addr().String(), tlsConfig)
+			if test.name == "system roots" {
+				require.Error(t, err)
+			} else {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientTLSErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+		want string
+	}{
+		{"conflicting CA sources", config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertPath: "missing", CaCertBytes: "data"}, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{"missing CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: "missing"}, "reading redis CA certificate"},
+		{"invalid CA", config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, "invalid redis CA certificate"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(test.cfg)
+			require.Nil(t, client)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, test.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
